chosenUnit.assertion: AT-self-improvement-54 requires a required component decision record to fail when absent, unsupported, or incomplete, and to identify the missing requirement/source/validation IDs. A complete record must include compared options, primary evidence, tradeoffs, a selected proven option outside the initially named tools, release gate, and test IDs, then pass.
chosenUnit.selectionReason: Smallest candidate remains the existing Self-Improvement research decision owner, but its current fixed M02 comparison check does not cover the full AT. Refine the existing owner contract and one registered probe rather than add a module or command.

currentProof.currentCLI: toy research check --json invokes EngineeringControl.checkResearch on the repository register.
currentProof.currentLimit: checkResearch returns register_inventory only, with admission=BLOCKED, wholeATsPassed=[], and acceptanceComplete=false. The current ResearchComponentComparisonCheckV1 exposes generic finding codes and selectedTool, but not missing requirement/source/validation IDs or selectedOptionId. The input schema has mappedRequirements and primaryEvidenceIds but no validationIds or testIds field; acceptanceIds is checked against specs/obligations.md. The check consumes the register row releaseGate separately from the comparison record.
currentProof.assignedRouteGap: TEST-PLAN assigns probe:AT-self-improvement-54, but ReplayEnvironment has no AT-self-improvement-54 dispatch and tests/registry.yaml has no source-bound manifest row. Existing public checkResearch can inspect a bound TS report overlay, but its current public DTOs cannot return the missing identifier lists or validation/test identifier coverage required by the assertion.
currentProof.existingProbeLimit: componentComparisonProbe is fixed to AT-obligations-74, component M02, and indexed report TS. Its four cases only fail for missing primary evidence, unsupported selected choice, and missing acceptance link; the complete case selects pg-boss. The report contains an outside option, but does not select it. It therefore proves neither the AT-SI54 missing requirement/source/validation IDs nor a PASS with an outside option selected. Reusing M02/TS can provide one required-component witness, but cannot prove the generic required-component rule: the validator hard-codes scope obligations-scheduling, requirements 0.1/0.2/0.10, named SQLite/pg-boss/Hermes options, and only requires comparisons for A08/A09/M02.

smallestSourceRequiredCases.expected: The required component has no decision record; fail and identify that component plus the absent decision identifiers.
Selected option is unsupported or unproven; fail and identify the selected option and source/validation identifiers preventing acceptance.
One bound decision omits a required requirement ID, primary source ID, and validation ID; fail with each exact missing ID, not only generic finding codes.

A bound decision has compared options, primary evidence, tradeoffs, a selected proven option whose ID is outside the initially named option set, release gate, and test IDs; pass and report the selected option ID.

minimalSourceUnit.m02WitnessAssessment: M02 is a current required component and TS is its indexed report, so it may serve as the single concrete required-component witness for this AT. It is not proof of a generic validator: current logic is scoped to obligations-scheduling, hard-codes requirement IDs and three named tool examples, and the current probe selects pg-boss. The AT-SI54 probe must directly assert exact missing-ID arrays and selectedOptionId for an outside proven option; the existing AT-obligations-74 four checks do not do so.
CLICommands: Current read-only inventory only: toy research check --json
Existing comparison probe (not AT-SI54 evidence): toy --env test --stack <UUID> probe run AT-obligations-74 --request-id <UUID> --json
Assigned unfiltered probe after implementation: toy --env test --stack <UUID> probe run AT-self-improvement-54 --request-id <UUID> --json
